/*# sourceURL=wp-img-auto-sizes-contain-inline-css */</style><style id="acf-profile-search-form-style-inline-css">/* Override WordPress cover block overflow to allow autocomplete dropdown */
.wp-block-cover:has(.wp-block-profile-search-form),
.wp-block-cover-image:has(.wp-block-profile-search-form) {
    overflow: visible !important;
}

.profile-search-form__form {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: var(--wp--preset--spacing--small);
}

.profile-search-form__input-wrap {
    display: flex;
    position: relative;
}
.profile-search-form__form .profile-search-form__input {
    padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--x-small)
        var(--wp--preset--spacing--x-small) var(--wp--preset--spacing--x-small)
        calc(var(--wp--preset--spacing--x-small) + 25px);
    font-size: var(--wp--preset--font-size--medium);
    border: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--border-light);
    border-right: 0;
    border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px;
    width: 300px;
    height: 100% !important;
    transition: border-radius 0.15s ease;
}
.profile-search-form__form .profile-search-form__input::placeholder {
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--main);
    font-size: var(--wp--preset--font-size--medium);
}
.profile-search-form__icon {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    left: var(--wp--preset--spacing--x-small);
    width: 19px;
    height: 20px;
    z-index: 2;
}
.profile-search-form__button {
    padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--x-small)
        var(--wp--preset--spacing--medium);
    border: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--main-accent);
    border-left: none;
    border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
    background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--main-accent);
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--base);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: var(--wp--preset--font-size--medium);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: filter var(--transition);
}

.profile-search-form__button:hover {
    filter: brightness(110%);
}

/* When results are open, remove bottom border radius */
.profile-search-form__input-wrap--results-open .profile-search-form__input {
    border-radius: 10px 0 0 0;
}

.profile-search-form__input-wrap--results-open .profile-search-form__button {
    border-radius: 0 10px 0 0;
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
    .profile-search-form__form {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: var(--wp--preset--spacing--x-small);
        padding: 0 var(--wp--preset--spacing--x-small);
    }
    .profile-search-form__input-wrap {
        width: 100%;
        flex-direction: column;
    }
    .profile-search-form__form .profile-search-form__input {
        width: 100%;
        border-radius: 10px;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--border-light);
    }
    .profile-search-form__input {
        border-radius: 10px;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--border-light);
    }
    .profile-search-form__button {
        width: 100%;
        border-radius: 10px;
    }
}

/*AutoComplete Styles*/
.autoComplete_wrapper {
    display: inline-block;
    position: relative;
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > input {
    height: 100%;
    width: 370px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 2rem 0 3.2rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    -moz-box-sizing: border-box;
    -webkit-box-sizing: border-box;
    font-size: 1rem;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--main);
    outline: none;
    border-radius: 10rem;
    border: 0.05rem solid var(--wp--preset--color--border-light);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > input::placeholder {
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--main);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > input:hover::placeholder {
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--main);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > input:focus::placeholder {
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--main);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > input:focus::selection {
    background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--tertiary);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > input::selection {
    background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--tertiary);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > input:hover {
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--main);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > input:focus {
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--main);
    border-color: var(--wp--preset--color--main-accent);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > ul {
    position: absolute;
    max-height: 160px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    margin: 0.5rem 0 0 0;
    padding: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    list-style: none;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--base);
    border: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--border-light);
    box-shadow: 0 3px 6px var(--wp--preset--color--border-light);
    outline: none;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease-in-out;
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > ul[hidden],
.autoComplete_wrapper > ul:empty {
    display: block;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > ul > li {
    margin: 0.3rem;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
    text-align: left;
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #212121;
    border-radius: 0.35rem;
    background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--base);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > ul > li mark {
    background-color: transparent;
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--main);
    font-weight: bold;
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > ul > li:hover {
    cursor: pointer;
    background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--tertiary);
}

.autoComplete_wrapper > ul > li[aria-selected="true"] {
    background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--tertiary);
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 600px) {
    .autoComplete_wrapper > input {
        width: 18rem;
    }
}

/*# sourceURL=https://www.influencewatch.org/wp-includes/blocks/group/style.min.css */</style><style id="iw-block-core_group-inline-css">/* Group Styles
--------------------------------------------- */

/* Background dots */

.wp-block-group.is-style-background-dots {
    position: relative;
}
.wp-block-group.is-style-background-dots > div {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}
.wp-block-group.is-style-background-dots::before {
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
    background-image: url("/wp-content/themes/iw/assets/styles/../../assets/images/background-dots-left.svg");
    background-position: 0% 0;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: cover;
    content: "";
    left: 0;
    max-width: 1041px;
    pointer-events: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 1;
}

.wp-block-group.is-style-background-dots::after {
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
    background-image: url("/wp-content/themes/iw/assets/styles/../../assets/images/background-dots-right.svg");
    background-position: 100% 0;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: cover;
    content: "";
    max-width: 1041px;
    pointer-events: none;
    position: absolute;
    right: 0;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 1;
    opacity: 0.7;
    overflow: hidden;
}

/* IW Logo Background style */
.is-style-background-iw-logo {
    position: relative;
}
.is-style-background-iw-logo > div {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}
.is-style-background-iw-logo::before {
    background-image: url("/wp-content/themes/iw/assets/styles/../../assets/images/background-iw-logo.png");
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-position: 0% 50%;
    background-size: cover;
    content: "";
    right: 0;
    max-width: 1041px;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 1;
}

/* Pull up style */

.is-style-pull-up {
    margin-top: calc(-1 * var(--wp--preset--spacing--x-large)) !important;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

body:not(.body--starts-dark) .is-style-background-nodes {
    background-color: #eff0f4;
    overflow: hidden;
}
body:not(.body--starts-dark) .is-style-background-nodes::before {
    background-color: #eff0f4;
    background-image: url("/wp-content/themes/iw/assets/styles/../../assets/images/nodes-white.jpg");
    opacity: 0.75;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-position: 50% 20%;
    background-size: cover;
    content: "";
    left: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: 1;
}
@media (max-width: 800px) {
    body:not(.body--starts-dark) .is-style-background-nodes::before {
        background-position: 100% 20%;
    }
}
body:not(.body--starts-dark) .is-style-background-nodes > div {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 3;
}

.profile-meta .profile-footnotes__number a {

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
    .profile-meta {
        align-items: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0;
        margin-bottom: 1em !important;
    }

    .profile-meta__image-layout {
        aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
        max-width: none;
        order: 1;
        padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--medium);
        padding-bottom: 0;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .profile-meta__image img {
        object-position: center center;
    }

    .profile-meta__image-layout--no-image {
        display: none;
    }

        order: 2;
    }

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .profile-meta__list {
        column-count: 1;
    }

/*# sourceURL=https://www.influencewatch.org/wp-content/themes/iw/blocks/profile-meta/profile-meta.css */</style><style id="acf-profile-hero-style-inline-css">.wp-block-profile-hero {

/*# sourceURL=https://www.influencewatch.org/wp-content/themes/iw/blocks/profile-hero/profile-hero.css */</style><style id="acf-profile-toc-style-inline-css">.wp-block-table-of-contents {

/*# sourceURL=https://www.influencewatch.org/wp-content/themes/iw/blocks/site-social-links/site-social-links.css */</style><style id="acf-site-footer-style-inline-css">.site-footer.wp-block-template-part {
    margin-top: auto !important;
}

.site-footer .find-a-profile-wrap {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

.site-footer .find-a-profile-wrap + .has-tertiary-background-color {
    margin-top: calc(var(--wp--preset--spacing--xxx-large) * -1);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.wp-block-site-footer {
    background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--main);
    border-top: 4px solid var(--wp--preset--color--primary);
    padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--medium);
}

.site-footer__container {
    align-items: center;
    display: grid;
    gap: var(--wp--preset--spacing--medium);
    grid-template-columns: 0.5fr 1fr 0.5fr;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    max-width: 1300px;
}

.site-footer__logo img {
    display: block;
    height: auto;
    width: 12.875rem;
}

.site-footer__nav-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: var(--wp--preset--spacing--medium);
    justify-content: center;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.site-footer__nav-links a {
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--base);
    font-size: var(--wp--preset--font-size--base);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.site-footer__social-links .wp-block-social-links {
    justify-content: flex-end;
}

.site-footer__legal-wrap {
    background: #030404;
    padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--xx-small)
        var(--wp--preset--spacing--medium);
}

.site-footer__legal {
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--base);
    font-size: var(--wp--preset--font-size--small);
    text-align: center;
}

.site-footer__legal a {
    color: var(--wp--preset--color--base);
    text-decoration: underline;
}

.site-footer__legal > :first-child {
    margin-top: 0;
}

.site-footer__legal > :last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* Mobile Footer
--------------------------------------------- */

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
    .site-footer__container {
        flex-direction: column;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .site-footer__logo img {
        margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .site-footer__nav-links {
        align-items: center;
        flex-direction: column;
        row-gap: var(--wp--preset--spacing--small);
    }

    .site-footer__social-links .wp-block-social-links {
        justify-content: center;
    }
}

href="#note-3">3</a></sup></p><h2>Background</h2><p>The Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation was founded in 2007 by Jensen Huang and his wife Lori. Jensen Huang is a Taiwanese-American businessman and technology entrepreneur best known as the founder and chief executive officer of Nvidia. According to <em>Forbes</em>, Huang’s net worth has skyrocketed, growing from $3 billion to over $100 billion in 2024, making him among the 15 richest people in the world. <sup class="profile-footnotes__number"><a href="#note-2">2</a></sup></p><p>The foundation is based in Palo Alto, California, and maintains a very low profile with little presence online or in the media. For most of the foundation’s history, it had under $50 million in assets, and mostly contributed to west coast universities, funding health and research programs. The foundation’s assets jumped from $42 million to $287 million in 2017. The foundation has also funded left-of-center advocacy collectives such as the <a href="https://www.influencewatch.org/non-profit/tides-center/">Tides Center</a> Depository. <sup class="profile-footnotes__number"><a href="#note-4">4</a></sup> <sup class="profile-footnotes__number"><a href="#note-1">1</a></sup></p><h2>Assets and Giving</h2><p>The Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation owns 69 million shares of Nvidia, and in line with the growth of the company’s stock price, the foundation’s asset value grew eight-fold from the end of 2022 through July 2024 to an estimated $8 billion, making it the 20th-largest foundation in the United States according to Bloomberg. <sup class="profile-footnotes__number"><a href="#note-1">1</a></sup></p><p>Huang was described by Inside Philanthropy as a “black box billionaire” meaning that he utilizes contributions from his foundation to donor-advised funds that receive the vast sum of his giving in the United States, circumventing traditional requirements for private foundations to disclose their grantees, as well as allowing the foundation to meet its annual legally required disbursements. <sup class="profile-footnotes__number"><a href="#note-3">3</a></sup></p><p>The Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation awards two-thirds of its giving to donor-advised funds. In addition, Huang and his wife control the GeForce Fund, a donor-advised fund (DAF) managed by DAFgiving360 (also known as <a href="https://www.influencewatch.org/non-profit/schwab-charitable-fund/">Schwab Charitable</a>). According to Bloomberg, DAFgiving360’s aggregated holdings include $4.4 billion in NVIDIA stock, “at least some of which” is held in DAFs controlled by the Huangs and their foundation. <sup class="profile-footnotes__number"><a href="#note-1">1</a></sup></p><p>A statement from the foundation noted that “The Huang Foundation supports higher education, public health, and STEM initiatives across the U.S., alongside local community organizations in the San Francisco Bay Area.” <sup class="profile-footnotes__number"><a href="#note-3">3</a></sup></p><div class="profile__data"><div class="wp-block-profile-data profile-data alignwide"><h2>Financial Statistics</h2><div class="profile-data__section profile-data__charts profile-data__charts--small"><div class="profile-data__chart"><h3 class="profile-data__chart-title">Total Assets</h3><canvas
